name: SoundVMethod
meaning: Byte offsets of the 15 virtual methods shared by g_vtblStaticSound 0x574458 and g_vtblStreamSound 0x57449C (the abstract base 0x57441C declares all of them pure except the destructor). Useful because the module calls its own methods through `*(code **)(*this + N)` and the decompiler shows only the raw offset.

name: SOUNDV_CREATE_FROM_WAVE
meaning: Create the buffer from a caller-owned WaveFile.

name: SOUNDV_CREATE_FROM_FILE
meaning: Open a .WAV path and create the buffer; the object owns the WaveFile.

name: SOUNDV_FREE
meaning: Release the buffer, the notify interface and any owned WaveFile.

name: SOUNDV_RESTORE
meaning: Restore a lost buffer and refill it. Called by Play.

name: SOUNDV_PLAY
meaning: Start playback. Pure on StreamSound - use StreamSound_Play 0x421230 instead.

name: SOUNDV_SET_PAUSED
meaning: (char bPause) Stop without rewinding, or resume.

name: SOUNDV_REWIND
meaning: SetCurrentPosition(0). Same function 0x420A40 in both tables.

name: SOUNDV_SET_POSITION
meaning: (float frac01) Seek to a fraction of the buffer. Same function 0x4212E0 in both tables.

name: SOUNDV_IS_PLAYING
meaning: BOOL. StaticSound asks DirectSound; StreamSound reads its own `stopped` flag.

name: SOUNDV_SET_VOLUME
meaning: (float gain01) Same function 0x420A80 in both tables.

name: SOUNDV_SET_PAN
meaning: (float pan) Same function 0x421390 in both tables.

name: SOUNDV_SET_FREQUENCY
meaning: (DWORD hz) Same function 0x420AF0 in both tables.

name: SOUNDV_FILL_BUFFER
meaning: Refill the buffer from the start of the wave data.
